issues.note: Second issue of 2026-09-04 (replaces the earlier 'Gauge' record; that issue — Vannevar on the 1886 Southern railroad gauge conversion, Linus deleting a line to see who noticed, Mina's 'Hollis Companion' teardown, Herbert on subscription/rate pricing — is archived at out/daily_read.2026-09-04.gauge.md; do not repeat those topics). This issue, mood Displace: Ada's history of the overlay planner's job vanishing — Atlas's one-level store, Sayre's 1969 CACM study, then thrashing and Denning's working set as the work relocating rather than disappearing; Alan's how-it-works on speculative decoding (draft model, rejection sampling, acceptance rate, latency vs throughput, batch-size regime); Claude's artifact essay on the APL Selectric typeball 987/988 designed in 1964 before any APL system existed, the 88-character limit and overstrikes, Iverson's 'Notation as a Tool of Thought'; Karel's fiction as an HR exit-interview transcript, a release-approval role hollowed out from the inside. NOTE: ELIZA is off-limits — covered 2026-09-03.
